canonical_project: Smart Zambia / Huawei National AI Data Centre (MoU)
notes: MoU signed 26 May 2026 (Office of the Vice President, A) for co-investment in a national AI data centre 'on Zambian soil', including joint feasibility study and training of 5,000 ICT professionals by 2028 (Smart Zambia page, A; Kwacha News B). Status MoU/intent only: site not public, no permit/power/construction evidence.
